name: Enraged Wildkin

faq.answer: Jaron Stoneshaper is an explorer who was digging in southern Winterspring before furious wildkin drove him away.
Jaron suspects he wandered too close to something the wildkin were guarding near his camp.
faq.q: Why did the wildkin attack the camp?

faq.answer: Jaron left his camp gear and an amulet he unearthed at the dig site just the day before.
faq.q: What did Jaron leave behind at the camp?

faq.answer: The wrecked camp lies in the snowy reaches of southern Winterspring.
Jaron escaped with his life, but he fears his companion was not as fortunate when the beasts struck.

sections.body: Jaron Stoneshaper fled for his life after bloodthirsty wildkin overran his excavation in southern Winterspring. The beasts tore through the campsite when he strayed too close to ground they were guarding. While Jaron escaped the onslaught, he fears his companion never made it out alive. Now he needs someone to brave the snows, locate his ruined campsite, and recover both his gear and an amulet he unearthed at the dig.
sections.title: Fleeing the Dig

summary: Bloodthirsty wildkin have driven Jaron Stoneshaper from his campsite in southern Winterspring. He needs you to venture into the snow to find his wrecked camp, recover his lost gear, and retrieve an unearthed amulet.
